cmd.001.008.description: Show what is new in the current version of Maple
cmd.001.008.notices_option: Enable or disable the new version notice in this server
cmd.001.008.title: What is new in Maple %s
cmd.001.008.intro: This is what the version I am running right now brings:
cmd.001.008.item.1: **Configurable logs**: deleted and edited messages, purges, joins and leaves, and AutoMod activity. Turn on only what you care about with `logs`.
cmd.001.008.item.2: **Warnings and kicks**: `warn` and `kick` are kept in the history and count towards automatic escalation.
cmd.001.008.item.3: **Twenty-one new reactions**: laugh, cry, dance or roll your eyes with a different GIF every time.
cmd.001.008.item.4: **Embed builder**: put together a rich message step by step with `embed`, no JSON wrangling.
cmd.001.008.item.5: **More utilities**: look up any color with `color`, the details of a role with `roleinfo`, and try four new actions.
